verdict.rationale: Microsoft Authenticator is a consumer and enterprise mobile sign-in app (push approvals, OTP codes, passkeys, Verified IDs), not a developer API product, so an interactive API reference with runnable examples does not fit this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships a developer API surface that would make the axis apply, and the probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
